## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or platform outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] CPU tests pass
- [ ] Web lint/test/build pass when dashboard code changes
- [ ] Docker Compose smoke test is attached when a protocol boundary changes
- [ ] No dataset, model weight, secret, or generated artifact is included

## Truth Boundary

- [ ] Model, simulator label, historical evidence, and mock output are labelled accurately
- [ ] No vehicle-control command is introduced
